summary: The global thread index starts a row grid-stride loop, and each selected thread traverses that row's complete CSR interval before storing. The host launcher caps blocks at 65536, passes the runtime iterations count, and its timed loop launches exactly that many kernels, then synchronizes the stop event. Main forwards the CLI count to this launcher. Compiled main, launcher, and called CUDA stub were traced through cudaLaunchKernel. All five native SASS architecture kernels (sm_60/70/75/80/86) were inspected through the row/nonzero backedges and stores.
